title: Nook Works Read-only Query Pattern Prototype
summary: 以 Daily Weather Batch 真實需求作 requirement carrier，完成 Read-only Query Pattern 第一輪 Functional / Architecture baseline；收斂 curated result、business/technical query boundary、enterprise-style server-side pagination/sorting、page navigation/page size，並留下 Master → Detail return-context 作下一 Pattern 的 known design pressure。
flow: Business Requirement → Functional Prototype → Review → Enterprise Query Pressure → Pattern Candidate → Next Requirement Challenge
